question: Pila ka beses dapat i-publish sa pamantalaan o newspaper ang notice of pending application para sa pag-usab sa zoning?
answer: Sa iyong tanong, ang mga kailangan nga i-publish ang notice of pending application sa pamantalaan o newspaper ay tatlong (3) araw sa linggo para sa tatlong (3) linggo ([S1] DEV120-CPDO-PDF0037-C001, printed page 666).

ground_truth: For re-zoning and reclassification, applicants must post a visible project sign issued by the Zoning Administrator at the site and publish a Notice of Pending Application in a local newspaper once a week for 3 consecutive weeks before public hearing deliberations.
